# Tutorial Island

For new accounts only: finishing the tutorial telejumps the player to Lumbridge (tutorial/scripts/tutorial.rs2:300) and nothing takes them back, so the world index's walk from the Lumbridge spawn never reaches the island or its bank (build.ts unreached report).
